question: NTPC and ______ have signed an MoU to set up a joint venture for 'renewable energy business'.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ONGC**__.

__
 
• **NTPC Ltd. and Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to set up a Joint Venture Company for Renewable Energy business**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) **is a crude oil and natural gas corporation owned by the Government of India.

 
 
• The operations are overseen by the **Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas**.
 
• Founded on **14 August 1956.**
 
 
 
• **NTPC Limited**, formerly known as **National Thermal Power Corporation Limited**, is an Indian statutory corporation.
 
 
• It is a statutory corporation incorporated under the Companies Act 1956 and is owned by the Ministry of Power, Government of India.
 
• Founded on **7 November 1975**.
 
 
 
• **Reliance Petroleum** is an Indian petroleum company specializing in oil and energy, owned by **Mukesh Ambani **of **Reliance Industries Limited (RIL)**, one of India's largest private sector companies.
 
 
• RPL was merged with Reliance Industries Limited on **29 September 2009**.
 
 
 
• **Coal India Limited** is a Government of India-owned Coal Mining and Refining Corporation.
 
 
• It is owned by the **Ministry of Coal**, Government of India headquartered in **Kolkata, West Bengal**, India.
